interest: Shows US tracking of the Emperor's stance on the Axis alliance and Japanese Army officer personnel changes, late 1940.
overview: Two 1940-41 cross-reference sheets: Grew's telegram on the Emperor's Tripartite-alliance stance, and a report on Japanese officer appointments.

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet indexing a telegram from Ambassador Grew reporting on the Emperor's position concerning the Tripartite Pact.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Telegram 954: Grew reports on the Emperor's position regarding the German-Italian-Japanese alliance.
subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet for Telegram 954 from Grew on Emperor's position on Tripartite alliance

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet indexing a military attaché report containing biographies of newly appointed Japanese Army commissioned officers.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Report 10299: a Military Attaché outline of biographies and appointments for Japanese Army commissioned officers.
subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet for Report 10299 from Military Attaché on Japanese Army commissioned officers
